SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER , QUOTATION_NO , REVISION FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER = 'KRKORE0212' AND RECV_FLAG in ('GA','CM') AND SND_CHK = 'N' AND ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' AND SO_CA_FLAG = 'SO' AND ATOB_UNIT_PRICE != 0 AND trim(ATOB_DATE) is not null AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND QUOTATION_NO NOT LIKE 'RE%' AND BTOA_DATE >= '20180401' GROUP BY BUYER , QUOTATION_NO , REVISION ORDER BY BUYER , QUOTATION_NO , REVISION
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.REVISION , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , RQDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , RQDT.ATOB_REMARK , RQDT.ATOB_DATE , RQDT.ATOB_TIME , to_char(sysdate+365,'YYYYMMDD') as TO_DATE , QTDT.LEAD_TIME FROM KEPRQDT RQDT, KEPQTDT QTDT WHERE RQDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND RQDT.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND RQDT.ATOB_SEND_FLAG= 'Y' AND RQDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE != 0 AND RQDT.BUYER = QTDT.BUYER AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = QTDT.QUOTATION_NO AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND RQDT.REVISION = QTDT.REVISION AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y'
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = sysdate WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND ATOB_SEND_FLAG= 'Y' AND nvl(ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0) != 0
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM = sysdate WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND ATOB_SEND_FLAG= 'Y' AND nvl(ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0) != 0
